svg.title: RuVector. Give your agents memory. Explore RuVector.
svg.desc: Local semantic search, persistent memory, graph relationships and learning from explicit feedback. Open the RuVector repository. Four illustrative examples cycle with matching explanations: graph relationships, semantic search, persistent memory and feedback learning.

g.text: Combine graph context with vector search.
Retrieve related information for your agents.
Bring useful knowledge into the next task.
Learning needs explicit feedback, not reads alone.
